title: 第1546章 又得阵法上第1545章 记得找我
content_zh:
比斗已经结束，长卿和枯荣宗等人回了居所，反正周枫给枯荣宗找的那些帮手基本上也不是藏着掖着的事情了，索性众人也都走到了一起。
“林师弟有什么计划。”
安顿好众人后，孙墨河问道。
“自然是想办法尽可能多的抢夺令牌了，这还用问么。”
长卿理所当然道。
“我们现在已经有了两块晋级令牌，我建议保守一点，全力守护好这两枚令牌才是正解。”
“守？怎么守？”
长卿反问。
“既然第二关是明天正式开始，今夜就注定不会安稳，虽然提前抢夺令牌是犯规之举，但肯定会有人提前踩点，计算好各个令牌的所在之处。”
孙墨河想了想，说道。
“我们枯荣宗独战两枚令牌，林师弟先前又如此招摇，很容易成为众矢之的，我们应该趁着今晚，在居所附近布置好陷阱以做防御，如果能够提前准备的话，毒法的优势还是很大的。”
骨幽姬却是说道。
“怕什么，现在进入第二关的一共也就不到一百人，平均下来一个晋级令牌也就不到十人在守，我们现在有八个人，正面对抗的话，我们不怕任何队伍。”
“蠢。”
长卿随口吐出一个字，便向门外走去。
“你说什么！”
骨幽姬在身后怒道，只可惜长卿完全没有理会，倒是孙墨河在身后不忘问道。
“林师弟，你要去哪里。”
“赴绝念剑尊的约。”
“那我们到底该做何准备。”

“你们想怎么准备就怎么准备。”
长卿头也没回，只是摆了摆手，顺手关门之际，说道。
“届时听我安排就行，我来兜底。”
他也没有隐藏身形，反正那么多人都知道有个不开眼的小子招惹了绝念剑尊，现在他去赴约，也合情合理。
一路径直来到了魏九凤的居所之后，长卿敲了敲门，听到魏九凤一声冰冰冷冷地应答，这才推门而入。
“前辈，我来了。”
长卿装模作样地说了一句，随后布下隔音灵，关上了门。
两人四目相对，魏九凤表情似笑非笑，长卿原本从容的表情也慢慢变得有些尴尬。
“娘子不说话是何意。”
魏九凤却勾了勾手指。
“来，你过来。”
长卿刚上前几步，就被她一把抓住衣领。
“今天当着那么多人的面，你很不给我面子啊。”
“哪有，哪有。”
“是么，得了一块令牌还不够，还得再赢我一次，你知道我演得多累么。”
“那不是因为有娘子罩着，做事方便一点嘛，我答应了枯荣宗给他们搞两个名额，回头好处自然是少不了。”
content_en:
The competition was over, and Chang Qing, Kurong Zong and others returned to their residences. Anyway, the helpers Zhou Feng found for Kurong Zong were basically no longer a matter of hiding, and everyone simply came together.
"Junior Brother Lin, what are your plans?"
After everyone was settled, Sun Mohe asked.
"Of course I want to find a way to grab as many tokens as possible. No need to ask."
Chang Qing said of course.
"We now have two promotion tokens. I suggest that we be more conservative and protect these two tokens with all our strength."
"Keep? How to keep?"
Chang Qing asked back.
"Since the second level officially starts tomorrow, tonight is destined to be unstable. Although it is a foul to snatch the tokens in advance, there will definitely be someone who will check out the points in advance and calculate the location of each token."
Sun Mohe thought for a while and said.
"Our Kurong Sect fought two tokens alone. Junior Brother Lin was so arrogant before and could easily become the target of public criticism. We should take advantage of tonight to set up traps near our residence for defense. If we can prepare in advance, the advantages of poison spells are still great."
Gu Youji said.
"What are you afraid of? There are less than a hundred people entering the second level now. On average, there are less than ten people guarding a promotion token. We now have eight people. If we face a head-on confrontation, we are not afraid of any team."
"Stupid."
Chang Qing uttered a word casually and walked out the door.
"What did you say!"
Gu Youji said angrily from behind, but unfortunately Chang Qing ignored her at all, but Sun Mohe did not forget to ask from behind.
"Junior Brother Lin, where are you going?"
"Go to the appointment with Juenian Sword Lord."
"Then how should we prepare?"
"You can prepare however you want."
Chang Qing didn't look back, he just waved his hand and said as he closed the door.
"Just follow my arrangements then. I'll take care of everything."
He did not hide his identity. Anyway, so many people knew that there was a blind boy who provoked the Sword Lord Juenian. It was reasonable for him to go to the appointment now.
After arriving at Wei Jiufeng's residence, Changqing knocked on the door and heard Wei Jiufeng's cold reply before pushing the door open and entering.
"Senior, I'm here."
Changqing said something pretentious, then put down the soundproof spirit and closed the door.
The two looked at each other, Wei Jiufeng's expression seemed to be smiling but not smiling, and Chang Qing's originally calm expression gradually became a little embarrassed.
"What do you mean if you don't speak?"
Wei Jiufeng curled his fingers.
"Come on, come here."
As soon as Changqing took a few steps forward, she grabbed her by the collar.
"Today in front of so many people, you are not giving me face."
"No way, no way."
"Really? Winning a token is not enough. You have to beat me again. Do you know how tired I am from acting?"
"Isn't that because having a wife to protect me makes it easier to do things? I promised the Kurong Sect to get two places for them, so the benefits will be indispensable."
